note: Open: the bands call reputation_poor acceptable, because the grade is medium. The call is that it is wrong here: the domain is 38 days old, and a middle grade is where a domain with five weeks of history stands, not a mark against it. Volume is modest and growing gently, complaints and bounces are minimal, nearly half the mail is opened and the grade has not moved down, so the warm-up is going as it should. Telling this client its reputation is poor would send it to change a sending plan that is working. On an established domain with the same grade the bands' answer would stand. General practice; that reputation is built over weeks of steady sending is the warm-up advice in M3AAWG's sender best practices.
